description: This Swift source file defines a theming module for a chat UI supporting multiple platforms (macOS and iOS). It includes color schemes, background styles, and platform-specific appearance adjustments, encapsulated within the 'OpenClawChatTheme' enum. It also provides image factory methods for platform-specific image creation.

methods.name: resolvedAssistantBubbleColor(for:)
methods.description: Computes the assistant chat bubble color based on the appearance (light or dark mode).

methods.name: resolvedOnboardingAssistantBubbleColor(for:)
methods.description: Computes the onboarding assistant bubble color based on the appearance.

methods.name: image(_ image:)
methods.description: Factory method to create platform-specific Image instances from OpenClawPlatformImage.
